title: Elulæus
summary: King of Tyre in the account of Salmanasar's invasion (Cory 1876). A footnote says the cuneiform form is Lulia. Not linked here to Shalmaneser I.
description: Added from the Cory import. Display only. Cory gives reign lengths and synchronisms, not a BC year this record can sort on, and no tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year (Cory is display-only and gives none).

reign.citation: Cory, Ancient Fragments (London: Reeves & Turner, 1876, ed. E. Richmond Hodges), p. 31; Menander, ap. Josephus, Antiquities
reign.note: The king of Assyria guarded the river and the aqueducts so that the Tyrians drank from wells. Five years is the length of that blockade.
